complete.description: Totals checked only with --complete, for a full content set.

basicRecovery.description: A basic attack's recovery, as a share of the weapon's base cooldown. Sets the Attack Speed ceiling.

abilityCast.description: An ability's cast time unless it states one.

abilityRecovery.description: An ability's recovery unless it states one.

armorRatio.description: Each physical hit loses armorRatio × the target's Defense, as a flat amount.

armorFloor.description: Defense can't take a physical hit below this % of its size. Absent or 0: enough Defense blanks a hit. Ignored when armorK is set.

armorK.description: Defense by the Path of Exile formula: a physical hit deals hit² ÷ (hit + armorK × Defense), so Defense is nearly linear against big hits and never blanks one. Replaces armorRatio and armorFloor when above 0; absent or 0, the flat cut.

taken.description: Bounds on a unit's total damage-taken modifier, in percent.

kind.description: A weapon kind: sets type, cooldown and hands. Any field stated here overrides the kind's.

cooldown.description: The base cooldown, in ticks. Required without a kind.

amount.description: Per hit: a base, plus whatever scaling the weapon states. Nothing scales it by default.

cast.description: Default 0: basic attacks have no wind-up unless the weapon states one.

stacks.description: Intensity: stacks added, scaled only as stated here, plus the applier's boosts that name the status or its tags. Default 1.

duration.description: Default: the status's own. 0 only for an instant lockout.

chance.description: Percent, rolled on the applier's dice. Default: guaranteed.

unarmed.description: The basic attack of a unit with no weapon.

maxEnemies.description: Most living units on the enemy side, summons included.

enrage.description: A fight that runs past `after` ticks: every unit, on both sides, deals pct % more damage with hits and reactions, and pct more again every `every` ticks, so no fight stalls. Absent: fights run to the safety stop.

opening.description: At fight start each action is already partly charged: it's first ready after a share of its cooldown, rolled between min and max on the unit's dice for each action (but see slots). Absent: every action starts a fight on its full cooldown.

slots.description: A party unit's abilities start this many ticks charged, by the order they're slotted in (first, second, third), in place of the roll: the order is the player's to choose. Its basic attack still rolls.

slotShares.description: As slots, but as a share of each ability's own cooldown (0.75 is three quarters charged), so a slow ability's head start is long too. Wins over slots when both are set.

draw.description: Foes pick in proportion to draw, not Aggro. With d how far a unit's Aggro is from `centre`: above it, draw = centre × (k + max × d) ÷ (k + d); below it, centre × (k + d) ÷ (k + max × d). An ordinary unit draws `centre`; none draws more than `max` times that or less than 1 ÷ max; +d and −d cancel. `k` sets how much the first steps count. Absent: picks weighted by Aggro itself. With `partyDraw`, this curve is for enemy units only (the party's picks among its foes).

partyDraw.description: How strongly a party unit draws foes' picks, in place of `draw`'s curve, which flattens at a few times an ordinary unit's. Aggro held between `floor` and `cap`; draw = centre × 2^n × (1 + f), with n whole doublings from `centre` and f the share of the next one. An Aggro-stacked unit can take most of the picks on its own. Absent: party units use `draw` too.

centre.description: The Aggro of an ordinary unit, which draws this much.

double.description: Every this many points of Aggro above `centre` doubles a unit's draw, and every this many below halves it; between two doublings it climbs evenly.

floor.description: Aggro below this counts as this.

cap.description: Aggro above this counts as this.

stagger.description: Copies of the same enemy start a fight this many ticks apart, one after another, so identical foes don't act in lockstep. Absent or 0: they start together.

focusAbilities.description: Default true: a focus (Marked) also takes the first pick of an ability aimed at a random foe. false: only basic attacks follow it (a switch for measuring the rule).

lostCast.description: An action interrupted in its wind-up, or whose targets are gone when it resolves. retry (the default): no MP, no cooldown, so it can start again at once. cooldown: no MP, but an interrupted action goes on cooldown, as a cast that fizzles for MP does, and one that found no target costs the unit its recovery.

control.description: Control resistance on bosses. Absent: none.

ranks.description: Enemies of these ranks resist control.

statuses.description: The control statuses: each one that lands adds a hidden stack (a Chill shatter's Stun included). One that doesn't land (Fizzle, an immunity) adds nothing.

resist.description: From `at` stacks, they land for pct % of their own length, and the battle text says RESISTED.

cap.description: The most stacks. At the cap they don't land at all, the battle text says IMMUNE, and they add no stack.

drain.description: One stack drains away this many ticks after the last stack was gained or lost, so a party that isn't chaining control sits near zero.

defeatedUnits.description: Knocked-out units stay down between fights until something revives them.

restore.description: After a won fight, every standing member regains these % of its max HP and of its max MP. Absent or 0: nothing restores them between fights (the core set's rule).

premiumChance.description: Chance each offered slot rolls a premium perk, if one is available.

repeatPicked.description: Can a perk already picked this run be offered again?

offerInapplicable.description: Can a perk no party unit can receive be offered?

name.description: Player-facing text. The engine never reads it.

kind.description: amount: takes flat or percent changes. points: already in points or percent; flat changes only.

brings.description: A status the unit holds while the stat is above 0, for behaviour beyond hit resolution, targeting and timing.

note.description: Designer note. Never shown to players and never read by the engine.

name.description: Player-facing text. The engine never reads it.

cooldown.description: The kind's speed: the base cooldown of its basic attack, in ticks.

hands.description: 2: a two-handed weapon, which empties the offhand.

note.description: Designer note. Never shown to players and never read by the engine.

items.description: A kind of weapon: its speed, damage type and hands. Every weapon belongs to one, and a class can use only its kinds.

name.description: Player-facing text. The engine never reads it.

note.description: Designer note. Never shown to players and never read by the engine.

items.description: An armor type or an offhand kind. A class wears only its own.

name.description: Player-facing text. The engine never reads it.

note.description: Designer note. Never shown to players and never read by the engine.

items.description: An armor type or an offhand kind. A class wears only its own.

name.description: Shown on its icon or sheet line, e.g. BURN.

text.description: Player-facing text. The engine never reads it.

label.description: Drives removal, conditions and the batch its pulses resolve in. marker: neither buff nor debuff.

show.description: icon: on the HP bar with its total. sheet: listed on the unit sheet. stat: shown as a stat.

tags.description: Tags that boosts (on its applications' stacks) and damage-taken modifiers (on its pulses) can name.

perSource.description: Per source mode: each source keeps its own copy, using `stacking`.

duration.description: Absent: permanent, until the fight ends.

cap.description: Intensity: the most stacks. `holder` scales read the holder.

live.description: Read whenever the holder's stats are worked out, from its other stats as they stand without this change (Thorns from Defense, Guard included), not once at application.

boosts.description: The holder's outgoing damage or healing, by tag. A scale `of: target` reads the unit being hit (Judgement, Brittle).

taken.description: Damage-taken modifiers. No tag: all damage.

absorb.description: Intensity only: soaks damage after mitigation, one stack per point.

block.description: Blocks the next damage above this percent of the holder's max HP, from any source, after mitigation and before absorbs; then the status ends (Aegis).

interrupt.description: A cast in progress that the lockout covers is lost (see ruleset.lostCast).

pause.description: A cast in progress that the lockout covers is held, not lost: its wind-up resumes where it was when the lockout ends.

riders.description: Adds a rider to the holder's hits that carry `on`.

adds.description: Adds to the amount of the holder's hits that carry `on`, before boosts, crit and Defense ("extra damage equal to a sixth of its Defense"). `target` is the unit hit; an Intensity status adds it for each stack. A bare hit takes none.

seek.description: The holder's actions carrying this tag (basic, ability or all) have Seek: their first pick ignores Taunt.

strike.description: After each of the holder's basic attacks: one more hit with the weapon's damage, of kind extra, at `to`. Extra strikes don't chain.

chance.description: Percent, rolled on the holder's dice. Default: always.

scale.description: A stat read live whose value is added to `chance` (Double strike).

to.description: The same target, or a rule (Arc: a second, random foe, excluding the target). A rule that picks several units strikes each of them (every other foe).

share.description: Percent of the weapon's damage each strike deals. Default 100.

kind.description: Default extra: an extra strike (Double strike's). bonus: a hit with its own name (Arc's second hit, a leap, a volley's arrow), which nothing that waits on extra strikes answers; on a unit other than the target it's `wide`.

carry.description: A bonus strike carries what the swing carries: the weapon's attached statuses, and the statuses the holder's basic attacks apply through its statuses' riders. Without it a bonus strike carries neither. (An extra strike carries the weapon's attached statuses, and the riders under `echo`.)

apply.description: Statuses each strike applies itself, as a weapon's attached ones (the acting unit is `self`).

stacks.description: Intensity: stacks added, scaled only as stated here, plus the applier's boosts that name the status or its tags. Default 1.

duration.description: Default: the status's own. 0 only for an instant lockout.

chance.description: Percent, rolled on the applier's dice. Default: guaranteed.

when.description: Only while the holder passes this, read as the basic attack resolves ("every third basic attack": a count at two).

tag.description: A tag its hit events carry.

chain.description: Each strike that lands rolls `chance` again for one more, at most `times` more after the first, each share % of the one before. It takes the place of a plain strike on the unit that reads the same `scale` stat (Flurry wraps over Double strike), so a swing rolls that chance once. The one bend of "extra strikes don't chain".

replace.description: It takes the place of a plain strike on the unit that reads the same `scale` stat, as a chain does, without chaining (Double strike's second strike landing elsewhere).

pulse.description: A repeating effect. Intensity: its trigger.

do.description: Absent: the pulse is only a timer, for an Intensity drop.

if.description: A pulse whose conditions fail does nothing that beat ("while any foe burns"); an Intensity drop still happens.

kind.description: Action and hit events, and ko, healed and overhealed: the kind of the action or hit behind it.

tags.description: The event carries at least one of these tags. A hit's: its kind and type, `crit` when it crits, `area` when its effect is aimed at several units, `wide`, `bare`, and any tag its strike names. ko: the killing hit's (`physical`: a killing blow). healed and overhealed: `pulse`. status_gained: `area`.

notTags.description: The event carries none of these (`area`: a single-target hit; `bare`: not a second landing or a left-over).

status.description: Status events; damage events and heals: the status whose pulse or reaction dealt the damage or healed.

line.description: hp_low and hp_high only, and required there: the line, in percent of max HP.

ability.description: Action events and ko: the action was one of these abilities, each with its trained forms ("when Backstab knocks a foe out").

does.description: Action events: the action does one of these, as an ability filter's `does` ("the next ability that deals damage").

paid.description: action_resolve only: the action was paid for, in MP or as an HP price (a free cast isn't).

counted.description: Action events only: an ordinary action or a paid second cast, which count as casts; not a free repeat.

wasBelow.description: Hit events only: the unit hit was below this percent of its max HP as the hit landed, before its damage.

other.description: Who the event's other unit is, from the holder's side: holder (a kill it landed, a status it applied, a heal or revive it gave), ally, foe, or any (there is one).

source.description: Status events only: the status was applied by the holder (a Mark it gave, an Aegis it gave).

seat.description: The unit the event is about sits in this seat of the party's formation (a position id, or next / previous from the holder's).

amountAtLeast.description: The event's amount is at least this ("a cast that paid MP": 1).

countAtLeast.description: action_resolve only: its hits landed on at least this many units of the other side.

repeat.description: true matches only a repeat, false only the first: an action event of a recast; a fight_start a `restart` made happen again; a status_gained of an application marked as a copy. Default: both.

drop.description: Intensity only: how far the total drops on each trigger.

crit.description: Turns crits on for its pulses, a rare exception. fromSource: statuses that know their source only, the source's crit stats and dice.

kind.description: Action and hit events, and ko, healed and overhealed: the kind of the action or hit behind it.

tags.description: The event carries at least one of these tags. A hit's: its kind and type, `crit` when it crits, `area` when its effect is aimed at several units, `wide`, `bare`, and any tag its strike names. ko: the killing hit's (`physical`: a killing blow). healed and overhealed: `pulse`. status_gained: `area`.

notTags.description: The event carries none of these (`area`: a single-target hit; `bare`: not a second landing or a left-over).

source.description: Status events only: the status was applied by the holder (a Mark it gave, an Aegis it gave).

seat.description: The unit the event is about sits in this seat of the party's formation (a position id, or next / previous from the holder's).

amountAtLeast.description: The event's amount is at least this ("a cast that paid MP": 1).

countAtLeast.description: action_resolve only: its hits landed on at least this many units of the other side.

repeat.description: true matches only a repeat, false only the first: an action event of a recast; a fight_start a `restart` made happen again; a status_gained of an application marked as a copy. Default: both.

actor.description: Who acts. source only for statuses that know their source. Default holder.

if.description: Checked when the reaction resolves, every one must hold: a side's state (as an ability's `if`, read from the actor's side) or a test of the event's other unit or owner. When one fails, the reaction does nothing.

unit.description: other: the event's other unit (as `to: other`); owner: the unit the event is about (as `to: owner`).

absent.description: The test also holds when the event has no such unit (a heal whose healer isn't known).

anyOf.description: Reactions only: the event's other unit, or the unit it's about, passes `where` ("the foe it hit is Sundered", "the ally that took the hit is below half").

unit.description: other: the event's other unit (as `to: other`); owner: the unit the event is about (as `to: owner`).

absent.description: The test also holds when the event has no such unit (a heal whose healer isn't known).

anyOf.description: Reactions only: the event's other unit, or the unit it's about, passes `where` ("the foe it hit is Sundered", "the ally that took the hit is below half").

split.description: Reactions that share this word and answer one event share its amount evenly (two pieces that move one fallen foe's fire, or carry one blow's left-over).

focus.description: Marked: the holder's foes' basic attacks pick a holder while one can be picked, by draw among several, under the Taunt rule (Seek follows it past a Taunting foe). So do their abilities aimed at a random foe: default targeting, a rule with no test but what its foe must lack, and a phrase that finds nobody and falls back to a random foe. An ability whose phrase finds its foe keeps its own targeting.

single.description: Marked: each applier keeps one copy: applying it to a unit ends the copy that applier gave anywhere else. Statuses that know their source only.

aim.description: The holder's basic attacks pick by this rule. When it finds nobody, the next in line picks: a Marked foe, then the default.

rule.description: Its Taunt rule is an action's own; an all-pick hits every unit it finds, each hit a basic attack's.

first.description: Ahead of a Marked foe. Without it, a Marked foe comes first.

mods.description: Changes to the holder's own abilities, read each time one is used. An Intensity status's changes don't grow with its stacks.

of.description: Absent: every ability the holder has.

ability.description: These abilities by id, each with its trained forms (a mythic naming its class's ability).

does.description: Abilities whose effects do one of these: revive, heal or damage, or apply this status (stun, silence, shield, guard...).

single.description: Abilities that aim at one foe: default targeting, or a rule that picks one foe first (not one aimed at every foe).

first.description: The first-slotted ability: the one the player put first.

basic.description: The basic attack, in place of the abilities: only `pay` and `wait` mean anything on it.

if.description: The holder passes this when the ability is checked and when it pays ("while it holds over half its MP").

mp.description: Percent change to its MP cost: −20 a fifth less, −100 free, +50 half again. Changes add up; the cost never falls below 0.

hp.description: An HP price, paid when the ability resolves: on top of its MP, or in its place.

pct.description: Percent of the ability's MP cost, as it stands after every other change's `mp` (a free cast costs no HP either), paid in HP as the pay effect pays.

share.description: Paid as the same share of the payer's max HP as the cost is of the caster's max MP, not point for point.

floor.description: The ability waits rather than leave the holder below this percent of its max HP. With a `payer`: the payer pays only if it's left above this, and otherwise the change doesn't apply.

instead.description: In place of the MP: the ability then costs no MP.

payer.description: The unit that gave the status pays, not the caster, while it stands and can (a status that knows its source). An ability it can pay for needs no MP.

pay.description: An HP price of its own size, paid as the action resolves (a basic attack's: `of: { basic: true }`), never below 1 HP. The action's amounts can read it (`cost: hp`).

cast.description: Its wind-up, in ticks, before cast-time reduction, in place of its own ("winds up in a moment": 1).

wind.description: Percent change to its wind-up, before cast-time reduction: +50 half again as long.

cooldown.description: Percent change to its cooldown: +100 twice as long, −100 none (it's cast again whenever it can be).

damage.description: Its hits deal this percent more, with the holder's boosts.

times.description: Every percentage of this change (mp, damage, heal, stacks, wind, cooldown) is multiplied by this count.

anyOf.description: The holder's stacks of this status (Cascade).

show.description: An Intensity status the engine keeps on the holder at its highest count, for the player to see.

anyOf.description: The times this ability has been cast this fight (counted casts, as the cast finishes), up to cap: a count kept ability by ability (Crescendo).

stacks.description: Its applications of these statuses (absent: every Intensity status) add pct % more stacks, on top of the applier's boosts.

heal.description: Its heals heal this percent more.

target.description: Its own target rule, in place of the ability's (the Taunt rule applies, unless it has Seek).

seek.description: It has Seek: its first pick ignores Taunt.

wait.description: It also waits for these, as its own `if` does.

apply.description: Statuses its hits apply as well, after its own.

stacks.description: Intensity: stacks added, scaled only as stated here, plus the applier's boosts that name the status or its tags. Default 1.

duration.description: Default: the status's own. 0 only for an instant lockout.

chance.description: Percent, rolled on the applier's dice. Default: guaranteed.

spread.description: Aimed at one foe, it lands on every foe instead, each hit dealing an even share of its damage (its share divided by the foes it lands on).

crits.description: Crits by condition on the holder's hits.

tag.description: Only hits carrying this tag (basic, ability, extra, physical, area).

when.description: Only hits on a unit that passes this, read as the hit lands.

chance.description: Points added to the hit's crit chance, after every stat change (100: it always crits, whatever else holds, Gambler's coin included).

times.description: The hit's crit chance, after every stat change, is multiplied by this before any `chance` is added (3: tripled against the foes `when` names).

cap.description: What this rule adds or multiplies never lifts the chance past this; a chance already higher stays as it is.

set.description: The hit's crit chance is this, whatever the stat and the other rules say: nothing raises it, and it wins over a stat set to a value (Gambler's coin). A rule that always crits still does.

bonus.description: Percent more crit bonus, the part of the crit multiplier above ×1: 100 makes ×1.5 into ×2.

echo.description: The holder's extra strikes are heard as basic attacks by its statuses' reactions and triggers that name kind basic, unless that status also names kind extra for the same event, or gives strikes itself. Boosts still see them as extra.

set.description: After every other change, the holder's stat is this value while it holds the status.

cover.description: When a hit on another living ally would deal it more than share % of its max HP, after its mitigation and before its block and absorbs, the holder takes the whole hit instead: it resolves again against the holder, statuses and riders included, keeping its crit and without a second dodge. A hit moves once.

tag.description: Only hits carrying this tag (`area`: every Area hit on an ally lands on the holder, once for each ally it would have struck).

lowest.description: Only hits on the ally with the lowest share of its max HP (ties: every one of them).

floor.description: The holder's HP can't fall below 1 while it holds this: a blow that would knock it out leaves it at 1, and nothing falls.

spend.description: The status ends (cause spent) the first time it holds a blow.

heals.description: Only its own heals land on the holder (its abilities, its Lifesteal, its statuses' reactions); heals from others, a Regen they gave included, restore nothing.

healCap.description: The holder can't be healed above this percent of its max HP, and loses what it has above it as the status lands (not damage, not a price). Healing past it is healing past full; at the cap it reads as just under it ("at half it counts as below half").

soak.description: Damage that would reach the holder's HP comes out of its MP instead, point for point, while it has any: after a block and absorbs, before HP.

divert.description: What the holder would gain goes to another unit instead, once: what's sent on isn't sent on again.

what.description: `mp`: every MP the holder would gain. Or a status's id: every application of it the holder would gain (a Shield).

to.description: Who gets it instead: the unit that gave this status, or a rule read from the holder. With nobody there, the holder keeps it.

party.description: A rule its side holds once: of the units on a side that hold this status, only the first standing, in slot order, answers an event with its reactions and trigger.

oncePerEvent.description: A counter: one event adds one application to a holder, however many of its reactions count it.

damp.description: Intensity with a cap: a chain of cappings dies down. Stacks an application marked `passed` adds to a unit are cut to pct % for each time that unit has capped this status in the last `window` ticks, in fractions of a stack.

swap.description: The holder's two stats are swapped as they stand from its class, gear and seat; statuses change them as usual after that.

tireless.description: The holder's basic attacks never wait on its abilities: it keeps swinging on its own clock through their wind-ups and recoveries.

order.description: Each time the holder is free to act, it uses one of its available abilities picked at random, whatever order they're slotted in.

borrow.description: The holder's basic attacks also carry the riders of another unit's: the statuses that unit's basic attacks apply through its statuses' reactions, on the same conditions, with stacks read off the holder, and never twice from a status both hold. What's borrowed isn't borrowed on.

from.description: Read from the holder ("the other ally with the highest Attack", the unit in a seat).

revives.description: Every revive the holder makes, from its abilities and its statuses' reactions alike (Einherjar).

ready.description: true: every action ready; false: every action on cooldown. It wins over the revive's own `ready`, and false wins over true.

hp.description: The HP they come back with, in place of the revive's (target is the revived unit).

confuse.description: The holder's basic attacks pick a random unit of its own side, itself aside (with nobody there, a foe as usual): Bewildered.

fixate.description: The holder's basic attacks and its abilities aimed at a random foe pick the unit that applied this status while it can be picked, under the Taunt rule (Fixated). Statuses that know their source only.

critsTaken.description: Every hit on the holder crits (always: Brittle), or none does (never, which wins).

owe.description: Damage from hits on the holder, after Defense and before its block and absorbs, isn't taken: it's added as stacks of this status (a `debt`) instead.

debt.description: Intensity with a duration: stacks added don't renew it, and when it runs out its holder takes its stacks as damage of no type, from nobody, which a block and absorbs meet (Owed).

rescale.description: The holder's abilities read `to` in place of `from` wherever they scale from the holder's own `from`.

to.description: The stat read in its place (default: the same stat).

best.description: Read from whichever living unit on the holder's side has the most of it, the holder included.

if.description: Only while the holder passes this.

sharesHeals.description: A rule its side holds once: healing any unit on the side receives is shared evenly by the side's living units.

drawBy.description: A rule its side holds once: foes' picks among the side weigh each unit by its max HP in place of its draw from Aggro.

spare.description: The holder's actions of this kind don't set off this Intensity status's trigger (basic attacks that don't spend Might).

source.description: starter: owned from the start (the starting classes, the plain weapons). unlock: everything else, found or earned in play. Free play makes everything available.

weapons.description: The weapon kinds it can use, first kind first: it arrives with the plain weapon of its first one-handed kind.

armor.description: The armor types it can wear.

offhands.description: The offhand kinds it can hold.

passive.description: The class passive. Its stat grants are stats; its behaviour lives in the statuses it applies at fight start.

name.description: Player-facing text. The engine never reads it.

text.description: Player-facing text. The engine never reads it.

statuses.description: Applied to the unit at fight start, and again when it's revived; usually permanent and unremovable.

note.description: Designer note. Never shown to players and never read by the engine.

items.description: A class is a unit. The player owns at most one of each and can field it once per party.

class.description: Owning class. Absent: an enemy's ability.

name.description: Player-facing text. The engine never reads it.

text.description: Player-facing text. The engine never reads it.

if.description: Checked when the action starts: what the ability waits for. Several conditions must all hold; `any`: at least one must.

target.description: foe (default): a foe by Aggro, under the Taunt rule. ally: a random ally. Or a stated rule. Chosen when the action resolves.

statuses.description: Statuses its unit holds while the ability is equipped, applied at fight start and on a revive as gear's are (a version that listens all fight).

note.description: Designer note. Never shown to players and never read by the engine.

upgrades.description: One for each ability and passive that can be trained. Absent: none.

id.description: The ability, or the passive status, it upgrades. Its five forms are content under fixed ids: <id>__p, <id>__a, <id>__b, <id>__ap and <id>__bp (UPGRADE_FORMS).

kind.description: ability: each form is an ability of the class, in pack.abilities. passive: each form is a status, in pack.statuses, that takes the passive status's place.

name.description: Player-facing text. The engine never reads it.

supplies.description: Supplies in the bag at the start.

start.description: Gold at the start; the draft after the leader: `picks` picks of one from `offers` classes.

startKnown.description: Classes that join knowing more than start.known abilities in act I, by class.

benchMax.description: Seats at camp at most; the others are won (a boon's seat, an event).

benchByAct.description: Seats at camp by act; a new act brings the run up to its act's (never down).

known.description: By act: how many abilities a recruit knows, rolled at random from its three.

benchMp.description: Share of max MP a member regains after each won fight it sat out (from the max it last fought with).

shards.description: Destiny Shards: every boss but the last act's gives one, up to `max` held; a lost fight can spend one to return to the moment before it began.

fresh.description: Share of its cooldown already run for a fresh ability: a starting unit's, a recruit's, one just learned.

drill.description: The Drill ground's pick of formations, or this many members trained.

formationOdds.description: By act: the rarity a formation offer rolls.

fixed.description: Floor number to the kind every node on it has.

odds.description: Room odds for the other floors, by kind.

lateFrom.description: Elites and campfires only from this floor.

ensure.description: Rooms of a kind an act has at least, where the rules allow.

campPaths.description: Mid-act campfires are added until at least this share of the ways up pass one before the last floor.

ref.description: Each pool's reference floor, where its fights' own knobs hold (default 1, 5, 6).

recruit.description: Chance an offer is a recruit.

supply.description: Chance an offer is a supply.

legendaries.description: How many of the offers are always a legendary piece.

trophy.description: A legendary piece is won outright, on top of the pick.

aimed.description: The first this many offers are pieces aimed at someone in the party.

formations.description: A second pick follows, of this many formations (an elite's).

extra.description: Chance, in percent, that a second pick of `count` pieces follows the first (gear only, from the same rarity table): a third more gear for the fourth slot.

mixed.description: Chance, in percent, that the pick mixes kinds: one piece of gear, then offers rolled from `mix` (the rest stay gear).

mix.description: Weights of the other kinds in a mixed pick.

bundle.description: A common piece and a potion or a tonic together.

seat.description: A seat at camp is among the options, while there's one to win.

mythic.description: The acts whose opening boon (the boss's before them) offers a mythic in place of its legendary piece: one for a roster member's class (the party first) that the run doesn't hold, while one is left.

slots.description: An offered piece's slot is rolled first, by these weights; then a class (the roster's, or one off it by `spoils.offRoster`), a kind it wears in that slot, the rarity, and a piece of that kind and rarity. Absent: every slot alike.

lesson.description: Members a lesson (a captive's or a stranger's) trains, each once (default 3).

cage.description: Chance the chest is a cage: a recruit with a piece suited to it.

camp.description: The share of REST those standing at camp get, whatever the pick (default all).

train.description: Members TRAIN teaches or upgrades (default one).

stranger.description: Chance a stranger at the fire asks to join.

auto.description: On arrival everyone recovers this (HP and MP, the fallen rise); then one pick, REST (`hp` and `mp` again, everyone) or TRAIN. Without it, one pick of REST, FOCUS, RAISE or TRAIN.

captive.description: After a won fight with any of `people` in it, a captive this often (never two fights running), taken in at `hp`%, or a lesson.

trainStep.description: A shop's training can be bought again in the same visit, each time this much dearer (learning and upgrading alike); without it, once each a visit.

gear.description: How many pieces of each rarity.

legendaryByAct.description: Legendary pieces a visit, by act (in place of gear.legendary).

drops.description: Offered as a choice of one after every won fight.

bag.description: Supplies carried at most, a slot a kind.

early.description: The climb a floor below a pool's reference floor (default `step`).

eliteEarly.description: The elites' climb a floor below their reference floor (default `early`).

knobs.description: Per act, added to each fight's own knob (HP +k %, damage +k/2.5 %): regular fights, the rise per floor from each pool's reference floor, elites, the boss.

shape.description: By tier (fight, elite, boss): HP % and damage % added to every foe on top of the knob, so a tier's fights can be longer and softer at the same cost.

growFrom.description: From this floor, each pack of two or more may gain one more foe.

levelGold.description: A level-up can be taken as this much gold instead.

neverGrow.description: Enemies whose packs never grow (Snakes: their Bleed doesn't shrink with a fight's knob).

hpBelow.description: HP below this percent of max HP.

mpBelow.description: MP below this share of max MP (what a Clarity waits for). A unit with no MP pool never passes.

has.description: Has this status (or every one of these).

lacks.description: Doesn't have this status (or any of these).

buffs.description: true: has any buff. false: has none.

debuffs.description: true: has any debuff. false: has none.

kind.description: Has a status containing this effect kind (narrowed by tag).

stacks.description: A status's Intensity total, in stacks.

atCap.description: Holds this Intensity status at its cap.

belowCap.description: Doesn't hold this Intensity status at its cap (or at all).

casting.description: true: in an action's wind-up right now (what Unmake waits for). false: not.

ko.description: true: knocked out, still in the fight. Sides list living units unless a rule asks for this. Default: living.

hasAny.description: Has at least one of these statuses (Stunned or Silenced).

lower.description: This stat is lower than the reading unit's: the acting unit in an action, a reaction's actor, a pulse's holder (an ally with less Defense than the wearer).

acted.description: true once one of its actions has resolved this fight; false until then (a unit summoned mid-fight starts false).

top.description: No living unit on its side has more of the highest of these stats ("the foe with the highest Attack"); ties pass.

others.description: Leave the reading unit out of the comparison ("the other ally with the highest Attack"); the reading unit itself never passes.

topHp.description: No living unit on its side has more current HP; ties pass.

canHeal.description: true: can be healed: below its max HP, and under any cap on its healing. false: can't.

weapon.description: Wields a weapon of one of these kinds (an enemy's weapon by its kind, if it names one).

offhand.description: Holds an offhand of one of these kinds; false: holds none (an offhand under a two-handed weapon is none).

offhandNot.description: Holds no offhand of these kinds (an empty hand passes).

armor.description: Wears armor of one of these types.

kin.description: Wields a weapon of the reading unit's kind; the reading unit itself never passes.

above.description: Its own `stat` is above `ratio` × its own `over` ("while its Defense is above its Attack").

ratio.description: Default 1: a percent stat against an amount reads the amount in points (0.001).

swing.description: No living unit on its side has a faster (slower) basic attack now; ties pass.

mostDebuffs.description: Holds a debuff, and no living unit on its side holds more.

hp.description: Current HP, or max HP minus current.

stacks.description: A status's Intensity total, in stacks.

when.description: 1 if the condition holds for the unit read (`of`), else 0: scaling from a condition instead of a stat.

event.description: Reactions to hit events only: `raw`, the hit's amount before Defense (after boosts and crit); `stopped`, what the unit's Shield soaked and its Aegis blocked of it.

cost.description: Actions, and the amounts statuses add to their hits: what this action paid, in MP or as an HP price.

count.description: A count, as COUNTS says: the unit's buffs or debuffs, an action's targets or the units its hits landed on, or the units on a side that pass a test.

stacks.description: The total of this status's stacks across those units, in place of their number.

times.description: Multiplies the term by a stat, or by a status's stacks, read live: "X% per point of Y" (Lifesteal, Siphon), "a twentieth more of the blow for each Spite".

seat.description: Statuses only: read from the unit in this seat of the holder's party, in place of `of` ("for each Spite the Wall holds"). Nothing if nobody sits there.

ifNone.description: When `where` leaves nobody, use the whole side instead ("if every foe is Taunting, any foe"). With `ko: true`, nobody fallen means the living side, by the rule's other tests ("a fallen ally, else the lowest").

exclude.description: targets: skip the action's chosen targets ("a second, random foe", "up to three other foes"). Reactions only: other or owner, skip the event's other unit or the unit it's about ("every other foe", "a random foe other than the one it hit").

seat.description: The unit in this seat of the party's formation (a position id), or `next` / `previous`: the seat after or before the reading unit's, by slot order, wrapping round and skipping empty seats.

anyOf.description: swing: the basic attack's interval now, its cooldown after Attack speed; highest is the slowest.
The highest of these stats ("the foe with the highest Attack").

hits.description: Actions only. Each hit resolves in order and reads the state left by the earlier ones.

riders.description: Actions only: extra instances attached to each hit.

apply.description: Actions only: statuses attached to each hit.

stacks.description: Intensity: stacks added, scaled only as stated here, plus the applier's boosts that name the status or its tags. Default 1.

duration.description: Default: the status's own. 0 only for an instant lockout.

chance.description: Percent, rolled on the applier's dice. Default: guaranteed.

oneOf.description: Deals damage. In an action, each hit is a hit; in a pulse or reaction it is not, and fires no hit events.

final.description: What it would restore past full is lost: it fires no overhealed (healing passed on isn't passed on again).

oneOf.description: Restores HP, never above max. Never mitigated.

final.description: What it would restore past the pool is lost: it fires no mp_over, and nothing diverts it (MP sent on isn't sent on again).

oneOf.description: Restores MP (positive) or drains it (negative).

stacks.description: Intensity: stacks added, scaled only as stated here, plus the applier's boosts that name the status or its tags. Default 1.

duration.description: Default: the status's own. 0 only for an instant lockout.

chance.description: Percent, rolled on the applier's dice. Default: guaranteed.

passed.description: Stacks passed on from a status that capped (a shatter's cold): cut by the status's own `damp` for each time the receiver has capped lately. An application made in answer to a passed one is passed too.

copy.description: A copy: its status_gained is a repeat, which `repeat: false` filters skip, so what copies a status never copies its own copies.

rider.description: In a reaction to the holder's own hit_lands, an application to `other` is a rider: part of what the swing carries. false: this one isn't (it isn't borrowed or carried, and a bare hit doesn't skip it).

oneOf.description: Applies a status, by its stacking mode.

label.description: buff or debuff; marker only with `status`, to lift one's own bookkeeping.

order.description: Which go first when fewer than all are removed. Default newest.

move.description: Each status removed passes to the acting unit as it was, its stacks and time left with it, unless the actor is immune to it (a buff stolen).

except.description: Statuses it never removes (the enemy-only ones a theft leaves alone).

oneOf.description: Removes buffs or debuffs, optionally narrowed to a named status or an effect kind. Unremovable statuses stay, and so do the buffs of a unit with immune:dispel.

hp.description: HP the unit comes back with (`target` is the revived unit).

ready.description: true: every action ready. Default: every action on cooldown, as at the start of a fight. The reviver's `revives` (a status field) wins over this.

after.description: The unit stands this many ticks later instead, if the fight hasn't ended and nothing has raised it meanwhile; the reviver needn't be standing then ("stands up a few ticks later").

oneOf.description: Raises a knocked-out unit, one knocked out in an earlier fight included. Its targets must ask for `ko: true`.

which.description: Which timers, as COOLDOWN_WHICH says. In an ability's own effect, longest and soonest never pick that ability on its caster.

set.description: What happens to them, as COOLDOWN_SET says.

oneOf.description: Changes the cooldown left on a unit's basic attack or abilities: ready now, a full cooldown, some ticks closer, a share of what's left, or at most a share of its full one. A wind-up already under way carries on.

drain.description: Lost, not paid: a drain or a drawback, which fires no hp_paid.

oneOf.description: A price in HP: lost at once, not damage, so no Shield soaks it, no Defense cuts it and nothing reacts to it as damage; it never takes the payer below 1 HP. It fires hp_paid. An ability's HP price is this effect on itself, after whatever reads its HP first.

share.description: Percent of the damage it's sized from. Default 100.

of.description: weapon (the default): the actor's basic attack against each target, its damage with the weapon's riders and statuses, in whatever shape its basic attacks have (their boosts). hit: the raw amount of the hit that set the reaction off (before Defense), resolved afresh; a dodged hit's too. dealt: what that hit dealt, again, as it is: no dodge, no crit, no boost and no Defense (a second landing); it's bare. over: what a killing blow had left over (a reaction to ko), which meets Evasion and Defense but isn't boosted or crit again; it's bare.

amount.description: A hit of its own size, in place of `of` (a blow from Attack, not from the weapon).

stacks.description: Intensity: stacks added, scaled only as stated here, plus the applier's boosts that name the status or its tags. Default 1.

duration.description: Default: the status's own. 0 only for an instant lockout.

chance.description: Percent, rolled on the applier's dice. Default: guaranteed.

kind.description: The hit's kind. Default bonus: a hit with its own name, which nothing that waits on basic attacks or extra strikes answers.

carry.description: The hit carries what the swing carries: the statuses the actor's basic attacks apply, from its statuses' riders (as an extra strike's does under `echo`).

by.description: Who strikes, in place of the actor: a rule read from the actor ("the other ally with the highest Attack strikes the attacker").

tag.description: A tag its hit events carry, for filters (`notTags`: a jump that doesn't jump again).

split.description: The amount is divided evenly among the targets.

seek.description: `to` is a rule that picks as an action's own would, past any Taunt: a Mark takes its fallback to a random foe.

after.description: With `of: dealt`: the hit lands this many ticks later, if its target still stands.

oneOf.description: Reactions only: a hit out of turn by the actor at each target (the dodge's riposte, a second landing, a blow carried past a kill). It fires hit events and never brings extra strikes of its own.

stacks.description: Intensity: stacks added, scaled only as stated here, plus the applier's boosts that name the status or its tags. Default 1.

duration.description: Default: the status's own. 0 only for an instant lockout.

chance.description: Percent, rolled on the applier's dice. Default: guaranteed.

of.description: The statuses to pick from, each with its own stacks.

same.description: One pick for every target, not one each.

pick.description: Not at random: the one its target holds the most stacks of (level ones at random); nothing on a target that holds none.

oneOf.description: Applies one of these statuses (or `count` of them), picked at random on the actor's dice.

which.description: event (the default): the action that set the reaction off. first: the actor's first-slotted ability, whatever its cooldown, if its conditions hold and nothing locks it out.

paid.description: The cast is paid for as a cast of its own, in MP and any HP price; if it can't be, there is none. Such a cast counts as a cast (`counted`), where a free repeat doesn't.

oneOf.description: Reactions only: an ability resolves again at once, with no wind-up, choosing its targets afresh by its own rule, its cooldown untouched; free unless `paid`. By default, in a reaction to the holder's own action_resolve, the action that set it off. The repeat fires its own action events, which `repeat: false` filters skip.

share.description: Percent of the stacks held, in whole stacks, rounded down.

oneOf.description: Takes stacks off an Intensity status the target holds (all of them, without share or count); under one stack it ends.

Every status of this label the actor holds passes to each target: the actor is rid of it, and it lands as a fresh application at its own length, with the stacks the actor held. Unremovable statuses stay.

ratio.description: A share of the stacks (default 1: the same).

oneOf.description: Reactions to status_gained only: each target gains the same status in the same stacks, as a copy. Only a status laid at a moment is shared: one with an icon that has a duration, stacks or a block; not a state its holder keeps while something is true of it.

plain.description: Only the riders every swing adds: none that waits for a crit, a tag or a test, and none borrowed.

oneOf.description: Reactions only: each target gains what the actor's basic attacks carry, in the stacks one swing adds. Two units answering one event add a status from one source once.
The start-of-fight effects of each target's gear and seat happen again: their reactions to fight_start, as a repeat (`repeat: false` keeps a price or a drawback out). One event restarts a unit once.
The actor and the target trade HP shares: each is left at the other's percent of its own max HP. Not damage and not healing: nothing reacts to it but HP lines.
Each target's HP goes back to what it was this many ticks ago, if that was more. Not healing: nothing reacts to it but HP lines.
Each target is knocked out at once: not damage, so no Shield, Aegis or floor stands in the way. The actor's kill, but no hit's.

hp.description: The summoned units' own max HP, +% (default 0); the fight's change to every foe applies on top.

oneOf.description: Brings new units into the fight on the actor's side, up to ruleset.maxEnemies living units on that side. They enter with every action on cooldown.
Each target leaves the fight (not a knockout: its statuses end, nothing reacts to a KO) and `count` new units take its place, up to the cap.

atLeast.description: At least this many pass. Default 1, or 0 when atMost is given.

atMost.description: At most this many pass (0: none does, "no foe is Marked").

seat.description: The unit in this seat of the party's formation (a position id), or `next` / `previous`: the seat after or before the reading unit's, by slot order, wrapping round and skipping empty seats.

healer.description: A class that heals or raises others.

from.description: The rarities a piece can be tempered from (default common, uncommon). A piece becomes a piece of the next rarity of its slot and kind that its wearer can wear (a rare one a legendary).

risk.description: Chance the piece cracks and is lost instead.

anyOf.description: Every fallen member rises at this share of HP.
n members (three, as every training opportunity) each take one training: learn an ability, or an ability's or the passive's power step or version.

gear.description: Each carries a piece of this rarity suited to it.
